description: This Swift source file defines a namespace 'SessionActions' that contains static functions related to session management, including patching, resetting, deleting, compacting sessions, confirming destructive actions via alerts, presenting errors, and opening session logs. It interacts with system dialogs, file management, and network control channels.

methods.name: patchSession
methods.description: Asynchronously patches a session with optional thinking and verbose levels via a network request.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a session identified by the provided key via a network request.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session identified by the key and prompts to delete transcript.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts a session up to a maximum number of lines to reduce size.

methods.name: confirmDestructiveAction
methods.description: Displays a warning alert to confirm a destructive action, returning true if confirmed.

methods.name: presentError
methods.description: Displays an error alert with provided title and error details.

methods.name: openSessionLogInCode
methods.description: Attempts to locate and open the session log file, launching code editor or file viewer accordingly.
